lines.text: Digging is a major part of our work, and it must be treated seriously.
Before any excavation starts, check the service information,
Only trained people may use the CAT and Genny.
Services must be located, marked, and exposed using the agreed safe method.
Never assume a service is exactly where the drawing shows it.
Don't enter an excavation unless it's been inspected, and confirmed safe.
Keep spoil, materials, and plant well back from the edge.
If you find an unexpected service,
stop work, and tell your supervisor.
Know what's below. Keep the edge clear.
